# Bloomberg
> Bloomberg is a global business, financial, and markets news platform offering journalism, data, analysis, and multimedia coverage.

Bloomberg.com combines real-time market coverage, business and technology reporting, opinion, newsletters, podcasts, and video. It also provides access points to Bloomberg Media products, subscription services, and topic hubs used by readers, researchers, and LLMs seeking current financial and economic information.

## News
- [Latest News](https://www.bloomberg.com/latest): Continuously updated stream of Bloomberg’s newest reporting across beats.
- [Politics](https://www.bloomberg.com/politics): Coverage of US and global politics, policy, elections, and government.
- [Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/technology): Reporting on tech companies, startups, AI, chips, and digital policy.
- [Markets](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets): News and analysis on stocks, bonds, currencies, commodities, and trading.
- [Economics](https://www.bloomberg.com/economics): Coverage of macroeconomics, central banks, inflation, and global growth.
- [Business](https://www.bloomberg.com/business): Reporting on companies, industries, leadership, and corporate strategy.
- [Green](https://www.bloomberg.com/green): Climate, energy transition, sustainability, and environmental policy coverage.
- [CityLab](https://www.bloomberg.com/citylab): Urban policy, transportation, housing, and city-focused reporting.

## Markets & Finance
- [Markets Overview](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets): Entry point for Bloomberg’s financial markets coverage and analysis.
- [Stocks](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/stocks): News and features focused on equities and listed companies.
- [Fixed Income](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/rates-bonds): Coverage of rates, bonds, yields, and debt markets.
- [Currencies](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/currencies): Reporting on foreign exchange markets and major currency moves.
- [Commodities](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/commodities): News and analysis on oil, metals, agriculture, and raw materials.
- [Wealth](https://www.bloomberg.com/wealth): Coverage of personal finance, investing, family offices, and luxury.
- [ETF IQ](https://www.bloomberg.com/etf-iq): ETF-focused reporting, analysis, and market commentary.
- [Crypto](https://www.bloomberg.com/crypto): Coverage of cryptocurrencies, blockchain markets, and digital asset regulation.

## Industries
- [Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/technology): Industry reporting on software, hardware, AI, and internet platforms.
- [Finance](https://www.bloomberg.com/industries/finance): Coverage of banks, asset managers, insurers, and financial services.
- [Healthcare](https://www.bloomberg.com/industries/health-care): Reporting on pharma, biotech, hospitals, and health policy.
- [Energy](https://www.bloomberg.com/industries/energy): News on oil, gas, utilities, renewables, and power markets.
- [Media](https://www.bloomberg.com/industries/media): Coverage of entertainment, advertising, publishing, and streaming businesses.
- [Real Estate](https://www.bloomberg.com/industries/real-estate): Reporting on commercial property, housing, and real estate finance.
- [Retail](https://www.bloomberg.com/industries/retail): News and analysis on consumer brands, ecommerce, and stores.

## Opinion & Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion): Bloomberg Opinion columns, editorials, and expert commentary.
- [Editorial Board](https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/editorials): Institutional editorials on policy, markets, and current events.
- [Columnists](https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/authors): Directory of Bloomberg Opinion writers and contributors.
- [Businessweek](https://www.bloomberg.com/businessweek): Magazine features, cover stories, and long-form business reporting.
- [Balance of Power](https://www.bloomberg.com/balance-of-power): Political analysis and reporting tied to Bloomberg’s policy coverage.
- [Big Take](https://www.bloomberg.com/bigtake): Deep-dive explanatory journalism on major business and global topics.

## Multimedia
- [Video](https://www.bloomberg.com/videos): Bloomberg video reports, interviews, clips, and live programming.
- [Live TV](https://www.bloomberg.com/live): Access point for Bloomberg Television live streams and schedules.
- [Podcasts](https://www.bloomberg.com/podcasts): Bloomberg podcasts covering markets, business, politics, and technology.
- [Audio Shows](https://www.bloomberg.com/audio): Audio programming and listening hub for Bloomberg content.
- [Graphics](https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics): Visual stories, charts, interactives, and data-driven explainers.
- [Photo Essays](https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics/photo-essays): Visual storytelling through curated Bloomberg photography.

## Newsletters & Subscriptions
- [Newsletters](https://www.bloomberg.com/account/newsletters): Manage and browse Bloomberg editorial newsletters.
- [Subscribe](https://www.bloomberg.com/subscriptions): Subscription offers and plans for Bloomberg.com access.
- [Gift Subscriptions](https://www.bloomberg.com/subscriptions/gift): Purchase Bloomberg subscriptions as gifts.
- [Student Subscription](https://www.bloomberg.com/subscriptions/student): Discounted Bloomberg subscription information for students.
- [Manage Account](https://www.bloomberg.com/account): Account settings, preferences, and subscription management.
- [Help Center](https://www.bloomberg.com/help): Reader support for subscriptions, billing, and site access.

## Special Coverage & Hubs
- [Equality](https://www.bloomberg.com/equality): Reporting on diversity, inclusion, leadership, and workplace equity.
- [Pursuits](https://www.bloomberg.com/pursuits): Luxury, travel, dining, design, and high-end lifestyle coverage.
- [Next China](https://www.bloomberg.com/next-china): Coverage of China’s economy, policy, and global influence.
- [New Economy](https://www.bloomberg.com/new-economy): Reporting and event-related coverage on globalization and economic change.
- [Hyperdrive](https://www.bloomberg.com/hyperdrive): Coverage of electric vehicles, batteries, and transport innovation.
- [Screentime](https://www.bloomberg.com/screentime): Media, streaming, entertainment, and digital culture reporting.

## Tools, Policies & Corporate
- [Authors](https://www.bloomberg.com/authors): Directory of Bloomberg journalists, editors, and contributors.
- [Search](https://www.bloomberg.com/search): Search Bloomberg articles, topics, and authors.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.bloomberg.com/notices/tos): Terms governing use of Bloomberg websites and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bloomberg.com/notices/privacy): Privacy notice describing Bloomberg data practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.bloomberg.com/notices/cookie-policy): Information about Bloomberg’s cookie usage and controls.
- [Careers](https://www.bloomberg.com/company/careers): Bloomberg company careers and job opportunities.
- [Company](https://www.bloomberg.com/company): Corporate information about Bloomberg, its businesses, and leadership.
